title: The Tiny Lantern Path
goal: Follow the tiny path inside the lantern and wake the moon flowers.
intro: The tiny garden inside the lantern has a glowing path. Your friends have clues and a tool to help you follow it.
recap: You counted the stones, heard Bo's clue, tied the vine rope, and woke the moon flowers together.
reveal: Surprise! Grown-up lifts a tiny moon lantern. The moon flowers glow and hum a soft goodnight song.
hook: Tomorrow, one moon flower has a tiny door hiding under its petals.

rooms.name: Tiny lantern path
lines: The tiny path inside the lantern is glowing. Shall we follow it together?
You found the way. Come back whenever you want.

rooms.name: Moss grove
lines: I hear a clue in the moss. Listen with me, and it will help us cross the stream.
You heard my clue and tied the rope. The path is open.

rooms.name: Robo's acorn workshop
lines: Beep! There is an extra discovery in my acorn workshop. You can visit whenever you want.
Your acorn star can stay in your backpack.

rooms.name: Moon flower hill
lines: Grown-up has a surprise up here. Help me wake the sleepy moon flowers.
Look how the moon flowers glow. You woke them up!

puzzles.title: Count the stepping stones
puzzles.prompt: Tap each glowing stone to step along the path.
puzzles.hint: Touch each stone once. We can count them together.
puzzles.goal: Tap each glowing stone to step along the path.

puzzles.title: Hear the clue
puzzles.prompt: Tap the letter that makes this sound: [[ɑ]].
puzzles.hint: Tap the sound button and listen again.
puzzles.goal: Listen to the clue. Find the matching letter.

puzzles.title: Wake the moon flowers
puzzles.prompt: Tap each moon flower to wake it up.
puzzles.hint: Touch each flower once. We can count them together.
puzzles.goal: Tap each moon flower to wake it up.

puzzles.title: Polish the acorns
puzzles.prompt: Tap each acorn to make it shine.
puzzles.hint: Touch each acorn once. We can count them together.
puzzles.goal: Tap each acorn to make it shine.

locks.label: Tie the vine rope across the stream
locks.hint: Find the vine rope on the path, then listen to Bo's clue in the grove.
locks.goal: Carry your vine rope to the stream
